sentences.en: Further elaboration or ornament would only detract from the perfection of its simplicity.
sentences.zh: 进一步的精雕细琢或装饰只会削弱其简洁之美。

sentences.en: This summary is too succinct; it needs further elaboration to make it understandable.
sentences.zh: 这个摘要太简略了；需要进一步阐述才能让人理解。

sentences.en: The professor provided an elaboration on the theory during the lecture.
sentences.zh: 教授在讲课时对这个理论做了详细的阐述。

senses.zh: 精心制作(或计划)；精致；详尽(阐述) 精心完成的东西；苦心经营的成果
